targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS effective_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS effective_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
SELECT pk.hv_soc AS "SOC", pk.hv_pack_v AS "HV V", pk.hv_c AS "HV A", pk.lv_batt_v AS "LV V"
FROM pack pk JOIN packet p ON p.packet_id = pk.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true
WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end ORDER BY p.time DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS effective_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS effective_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
SELECT th.motor_temp AS "motor", th.inverter_temp AS "inverter", th.inverter_hotspot_temp AS "hotspot", th.batt_loop_batt_temp AS "battery", GREATEST(th.motor_temp, th.inverter_temp, th.inverter_hotspot_temp, th.batt_loop_batt_temp) AS "max"
FROM thermal th JOIN packet p ON p.packet_id = th.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true
WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end ORDER BY p.time DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS effective_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS effective_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
, base AS (
  SELECT p.time, pk.hv_soc, pk.hv_pack_v, pk.hv_c, pk.lv_batt_v, th.motor_temp, th.inverter_temp, th.inverter_hotspot_temp, th.batt_loop_batt_temp, th.coolant_flow_lpm
  FROM packet p
  LEFT JOIN pack pk ON pk.packet_id = p.packet_id
  LEFT JOIN thermal th ON th.packet_id = p.packet_id
  JOIN bounds ON true
  WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end
)
SELECT 'HV SOC min' AS metric, ROUND(MIN(hv_soc)::numeric, 2) AS value, '%' AS unit FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'HV voltage min', ROUND(MIN(hv_pack_v)::numeric, 1), 'V' FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'HV current peak', ROUND(MAX(ABS(hv_c))::numeric, 1), 'A' FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'LV voltage min', ROUND(MIN(lv_batt_v)::numeric, 2), 'V' FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'Motor temp max', ROUND(MAX(motor_temp)::numeric, 1), 'C' FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'Inverter hotspot max', ROUND(MAX(inverter_hotspot_temp)::numeric, 1), 'C' FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'Battery loop max', ROUND(MAX(batt_loop_batt_temp)::numeric, 1), 'C' FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'Coolant flow min', ROUND(MIN(coolant_flow_lpm)::numeric, 2), 'L/min' FROM base;

WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS effective_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS effective_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(p.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time,
       AVG(pk.hv_pack_v) AS "pack voltage [V]",
       AVG(pk.hv_c) AS "pack current [A]",
       AVG(pk.hv_soc) AS "SOC [%]",
       AVG(pk.hv_pack_v * pk.hv_c / 1000.0) AS "pack power [kW]",
       AVG(pk.dc_bus_v) AS "DC bus [V]"
FROM pack pk JOIN packet p ON p.packet_id = pk.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true
WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS effective_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS effective_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
, cell_t AS (
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(p.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, UNNEST(pk.cells_temps) AS value
  FROM pack pk JOIN packet p ON p.packet_id = pk.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true
  WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end
), thermal_t AS (
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(p.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time,
         AVG(th.motor_temp) AS motor_temp, AVG(th.inverter_temp) AS inverter_temp, AVG(th.inverter_hotspot_temp) AS inverter_hotspot_temp,
         AVG(th.batt_loop_batt_temp) AS batt_temp, AVG(th.coolant_temp) AS coolant_temp
  FROM thermal th JOIN packet p ON p.packet_id = th.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true
  WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT thermal_t.time,
       thermal_t.motor_temp AS "motor [C]", thermal_t.inverter_temp AS "inverter [C]", thermal_t.inverter_hotspot_temp AS "inverter hotspot [C]", thermal_t.batt_temp AS "battery loop [C]", thermal_t.coolant_temp AS "coolant [C]",
       MIN(cell_t.value) AS "cell min [C]", AVG(cell_t.value) AS "cell avg [C]", MAX(cell_t.value) AS "cell max [C]"
FROM thermal_t LEFT JOIN cell_t ON cell_t.time = thermal_t.time
GROUP BY thermal_t.time, thermal_t.motor_temp, thermal_t.inverter_temp, thermal_t.inverter_hotspot_temp, thermal_t.batt_temp, thermal_t.coolant_temp
ORDER BY thermal_t.time;

WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS effective_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS effective_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
, cell_v AS (
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(p.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, UNNEST(pk.cells_v) AS value
  FROM pack pk JOIN packet p ON p.packet_id = pk.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true
  WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end
)
SELECT time, MIN(value) AS "cell min [V]", AVG(value) AS "cell avg [V]", MAX(value) AS "cell max [V]", MAX(value) - MIN(value) AS "spread [V]"
FROM cell_v GROUP BY time ORDER BY time;

WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS effective_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS effective_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(p.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dh.stomp_fault THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stomp_fault,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dl.bmb_comm_error THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bmb_comm_error,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dl.imd_gnd_isolation_error THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS imd_gnd_isolation_error,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dl.shutdown_leg1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shutdown_leg1,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dl.shutdown_leg2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shutdown_leg2,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dl.shutdown_leg3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shutdown_leg3,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dl.shutdown_leg4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shutdown_leg4,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dh.neg_hv_contactor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_hv_contactor,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dh.pos_hv_contactor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pos_hv_contactor,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dh.precharge_contactor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS precharge_contactor
FROM packet p
LEFT JOIN diagnostics_high dh ON dh.packet_id = p.packet_id
LEFT JOIN diagnostics_low dl ON dl.packet_id = p.packet_id
JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true
WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;
